The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ed88aa5ba802311a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. statement: In the setup of Section 4.1, put r = vq(N) and m = 1 + (q − 1)r, and let k/K have degree qr. Let dm ∈ J have a degree-zero divisor representative over k and satisfy λmdm = [Ne]. For 1 ≤ t ≤ m, set dt = λm−t dm, Wt = λ−(t−1) Ne ∈ Λ, (4.12) and choose any degree-zero divisor Dt over k representing dt. The lattice divisions defining Wt exist and are unique. Starting at t = 1, make the following test, advancing to t + 1 only when all labels at t agree. Choose ht ∈ k(C)∗ and γt ∈ k∗ such that div(ht) = (1 − σ)Dt − Wt, γq t = Norm(ht), (4.13) and form the labels li,t = vPi (Dt) − logζ ht(Pi)/γt  in Fq. (4.14) At every reached test these choices exist over k and the labels are defined. For some reached t ≤ m, the labels are not all equal. This conclusion holds for every choice of the representatives Dt and of the functions and roots in (4.13).
